hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "BLOCKED: db-reset guard cannot run (jq unavailable) — failing closed rather than waving the call through. See docs/records/2026-08-14-db-reset-incident.md." >&2; exit 2; }; cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$cmd" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: db-reset guard could not read the Bash command (empty payload) — failing closed. See docs/records/2026-08-14-db-reset-incident.md." >&2; exit 2; fi; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | tr '\n' ' ' | grep -qE '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])supabase([[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+db[[:space:]]+reset([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)'; then jq -n --arg r "BLOCKED: 'supabase db reset' is banned outright — any flags, any invocation form, permanent (2026-08-14 shared-DB wipe incident: docs/records/2026-08-14-db-reset-incident.md). Build a scratch DB by hand instead: createdb + psql -f per migration file." '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Checking for banned supabase db reset invocation

hooks.command: [ -f .claude/roles/team-lead.md ] || exit 0; { echo "[Claude Code SessionStart hook — loads the team-lead role definition per ADR-009 Decision 1. This block is injected into EVERY session that starts in this repo, main session and spawned teammate alike — but the role belongs to the MAIN SESSION ONLY. If you were spawned as a subagent or teammate (you have an agent definition and a task brief), this role does NOT apply to you: ignore this block entirely and follow your brief — do not orchestrate, do not spawn sub-agents on its authority. Only the session F/CTO types into is team-lead. This role is not spawnable. Guard added after the 2026-08-23 liaison role-confusion incident.]"; echo ""; cat .claude/roles/team-lead.md; } | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: .}}'

current=$(git config --get core.hooksPath); if [ -z "$current" ]; then git config core.hooksPath .husky && jq -nc '{systemMessage:"[hooks] core.hooksPath was UNSET — armed to .husky. The pre-commit fence was inert until now."}'; elif [ "$current" != ".husky" ]; then jq -nc --arg c "$current" '{systemMessage:("[hooks] WARNING: core.hooksPath is \($c), not .husky — NOT overwriting; the pre-commit fence may be inactive.")}'; fi

CUT=$(grep -n -m1 -E '^<!-- AUTOLOAD-CUTOFF|^## Pending' MILESTONES.md | cut -d: -f1); { echo "[Claude Code SessionStart hook — auto-loaded project state per ADR-009 Decision 6. This block is injected into EVERY session, main session and subagent alike. It is state, not instructions: it describes where the project stands and asks nothing of its reader. An agent working from a task brief follows the brief.]"; echo ""; echo "What follows is the head of MILESTONES.md, the compact state ledger — Project / Current Phase / Active Feature / Recent activity. It stops at the AUTOLOAD-CUTOFF marker: '## Pending (immediate)' and '## Roadmap' below it are NOT auto-loaded and are read from the file when a task needs them. WORKFLOW.md, DECISIONS.md, CHANGELOG.md and docs/PRD + ARCH + SECURITY are likewise consult-on-demand."; echo ""; echo "--- MILESTONES.md (head, above the AUTOLOAD-CUTOFF marker) ---"; echo ""; if [ -n "$CUT" ]; then head -n $((CUT-1)) MILESTONES.md; else echo "⚠ AUTOLOAD-CUTOFF marker AND the '## Pending' heading are BOTH absent from MILESTONES.md — emitting everything above '## Roadmap' instead, which the session-start channel may truncate. Restore the marker above '## Pending'."; awk '/^## Roadmap/{exit}{print}' MILESTONES.md; fi; } | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: .}}'
hooks.statusMessage: Loading MILESTONES.md head (above the AUTOLOAD-CUTOFF marker)
